summary: AB Private Lending Fund files an 8-K reporting three routine items: unregistered sale of 9,314 Class I shares for $229,133 under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, a regular monthly distribution of $0.20 per Class I share payable to holders of record July 31, 2026, and the NAV per share as of June 30, 2026 ($24.60 for Class I). The filing also notes the ongoing public continuous offering of up to $1.0 billion in shares. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or strategic review is disclosed. This is a routine periodic report of ordinary funding and distribution activities for a BDC.
